# Marketing Hub / GitHub Copilot

For marketing, planning, editorial review and brand-voice tasks, follow `skills/marketinghub/SKILL.md` with the user-provided brand profile. Do not apply this marketing persona to unrelated code tasks.

In a client without skill discovery, read `prompts/marketinghub-universal.md` as standalone instructions. Do not claim an action on social networks unless a connected tool executed it.
